baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذَرْنِي and وَحِيدًا join an imperative of leaving to a state of separateness around the speaker and the created person.
baseline_models.mechanism: The addressee is withdrawn from a two-party encounter: the created person is isolated from intermediaries and left to the Creator's direct dealing.

activation_trace.role: Leaving or letting something be supplies the imperative transfer by which the addressee relinquishes intervention.
Isolation and separateness turns the transfer into an exclusive encounter rather than simple neglect.

changed_reading.after: Withdraw from the case and leave the Creator and created person in a direct, unmediated encounter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا permits وَحِيدًا to describe the object at the moment denoted by creation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Origination establishes the person's first condition as a solitary creature, before any relationship or extension beyond that bounded self is considered.

activation_trace.role: Originating and bringing into being supplies the temporal starting point of the person's condition.
Isolation and separateness characterizes that starting point as unsupported singular existence.

changed_reading.before: I created a man who happens to be alone.
changed_reading.after: I brought him into being in an original zero-state of solitary creaturehood.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَلَقْتُ and وَحِيدًا can be heard through measuring and numerical-singularity branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation is deliberate apportionment, while aloneness marks the result as one bounded unit or case; individuality is designed rather than accidental.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning supplies deliberate calibration before the formed result.
The numeral one and single-unit image makes the person a bounded individually counted case.

changed_reading.before: Alone describes an emotional or social condition.
changed_reading.after: The person is a deliberately proportioned single unit, individually delimited by the act of creation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The complete-form branch of خَلَقْتُ can combine with the peerless branch of وَحِيدًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The created person appears as a singular specimen without an equal. The focus alone leaves the valuation open: exceptional distinction could become praise, blame, or merely unmatched status.

activation_trace.role: Complete and well-proportioned form supplies the image of a fully realized specimen.
Peerless uniqueness makes that specimen unmatched while leaving the value of the distinction unresolved.

changed_reading.after: The person is presented as an unmatched created specimen, with the valence of that distinction still open.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening imperatives assign the messenger warning, deliberate separation, and restrained endurance; ذَرْنِي then marks the boundary where that assigned action ends and direct divine dealing begins.

activation_trace.role: Leaving or letting be supplies the handoff command at the focus boundary.
Separateness gives the handoff an exclusive relational endpoint.
Fear-awakening warning supplies the messenger's prior outward duty before relinquishment.
Cutting off and parting supplies deliberate disengagement rather than passive inattention.
Holding the self back from distress supplies the controlled posture in which the case is released.

structural_cues: The opening command sequence moves through warning, separation, and patient restraint before the focus imperative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the warning-separation-restraint sequence; I infer a role boundary at ذَرْنِي, while a live alternative is that the focus is an independent threat formula with no procedural handoff.

changed_reading.before: Leave the case to the speaker.
changed_reading.after: Once warning is delivered, the messenger must disengage without panic or overreach and transfer the opponent's case to direct divine handling.

context_deltas.mechanism: The solitary creation state becomes a temporal zero point. The following sequence layers a made condition, abundant property, connected extension, filial lineage, present company, and prepared ease around that original single person.

activation_trace.role: Origination supplies the person's initial state before later additions.
Isolation and separateness marks that initial state as bare singularity.
Causing something to become a condition marks the later surroundings as conferred states.
Possession and abundance of wealth supplies the material expansion beyond original aloneness.
Drawing something out into connected length makes the wealth an extended support rather than a momentary item.
Sonship and lineage supplies a social and genealogical network around the once-solitary person.
Presence with witnessing makes that filial network immediately available and visible.
Preparing and leveling an affair supplies an environment made easy around the beneficiary.

structural_cues: The focus's created-alone clause is followed by first-person grants in 74:12-14, with each new support added after the creation statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies solitary creation followed by material, familial, present, and prepared extensions; I infer a temporal and causal contrast, while وَحِيدًا could instead denote distinction without implying an initial lack of support.

changed_reading.after: He began as a lone created person, and every extension of wealth, lineage, company, and ease is a later bestowed layer for which he can be called to account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The potentially honorific peerless branch of وَحِيدًا is recoded by appetite for further increase and by a stance that deviates to one side: singular distinction becomes self-exemption and refusal rather than praise.

activation_trace.role: Peerless uniqueness supplies an initially open claim to exceptional status.
The heart's covetous hope makes exceptional status function as unsated expectation.
Seeking increase supplies the specific direction of that expectation: more beyond the accumulated gifts.
Inclining to a side and separating from the group turns singularity into a resistant, self-isolating stance.

structural_cues: The desire for addition in 74:15 is immediately refused in 74:16 and paired with resistance to the signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies peerlessness, appetite for increase, and lateral separation; I infer self-exceptionalizing entitlement, while neutral social solitude remains a live alternative sense of وَحِيدًا.

changed_reading.before: The created person may be peerless, with the value of that distinction open.
changed_reading.after: He behaves as though uniquely entitled to endless addition and sets himself apart from the common claim of the signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus presents true creative proportioning; the created person later thinks, repeatedly proportions a rhetorical plan, and emits an invented attribution. He becomes a dependent counter-measurer who tries to redesign the status of what confronts him.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning supplies the Creator's prior formative act.
The heart's repeated turning over supplies the creature's deliberative workshop.
Planning an affair through estimation supplies the creature's calculated counter-design.
Saying what was not or falsely attributing it makes the calculated result a manufactured verbal classification.

structural_cues: 74:18-25 stages thought, repeated estimation, looking, facial reaction, turning away, and only then the spoken classification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creative measuring and a later think-estimate-say sequence; I infer an asymmetry between formation and derivative counter-formulation, while the sequence may simply portray deliberation without intentionally echoing خَلَقْتُ.

changed_reading.before: The speaker deliberately formed one individual.
changed_reading.after: The formed individual answers true proportioning with a derivative counter-design, engineering a verbal category meant to neutralize the signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated root reverses polarity and agent: the addressee is commanded to leave the person, while the later punitive process neither preserves a remainder nor leaves anything. The apparent release is therefore a transfer into exhaustive non-release.

activation_trace.role: Leaving or letting be supplies the initial positive imperative of release.
Continuance and remaining are explicitly denied, closing the possibility that anything is preserved.
The same leaving image under negation supplies the reversal: the later agent refuses to release.

structural_cues: The focus imperative ذَرْ and the later negated تَذَرُ share the root, while 74:28 pairs the latter with لَا تُبْقِي.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a positive imperative followed by an exhaustive negative pair; I infer a narrative handoff from human leaving to punitive non-leaving, while the recurrence could be lexical emphasis without a designed transfer relation.

changed_reading.before: Leave him to Me, with the consequence unspecified.
changed_reading.after: Release him from human handling because the announced process is defined by preserving no remainder and releasing nothing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Numerical singularity in the focus is drawn into a wider measured order: units are enumerated, enumeration becomes an assay, and a later threat is one member of a greater class. Singling out exposes the person to measure rather than exempting him from it.

activation_trace.role: Proportioning supplies the focus person's placement within deliberate measure.
The numeral-one branch supplies the person as a single measured unit.
Counting the enumerated supplies a larger order in which single units acquire force.
Assaying metal or a person turns the counted arrangement into a disclosure under test.
One in counting and composition shows singularity as membership in a measured class, not autonomous peerlessness.

structural_cues: 74:31 explicitly joins number to trial, and 74:35 uses a one-of construction for the great warnings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies numerical one, enumeration, assay, and one-of composition; I infer that the focus person's singularization functions as exposure to measure, while وَحِيدًا may remain purely social rather than numerical.

changed_reading.before: The created individual is exceptional and outside comparison.
changed_reading.after: He is singled out as one unit inside a measured order, where individuation exposes rather than exempts him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The universal rule encloses each self as its own essence, ties it to what it acquired, and holds it as security for that claim. The focus aloneness becomes juridical individuation: neither entourage nor status merges one person's liability into another's.

activation_trace.role: The single-unit image supplies the bounded individual who cannot dissolve into a collective account.
Comprehensive totality makes the rule cover every case without a privileged omission.
The thing's own self or essence identifies the indivisible bearer of the account.
Seeking and acquiring a gain supplies the self-produced basis of liability.
Property held as security for a right supplies the legal mechanism binding each self to its acquisition.

structural_cues: 74:38 uses a universal singular construction in which each self is linked to its own earning and pledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies every self, its acquisition, and its being held as security; I infer that original aloneness anticipates nontransferable liability, while the focus may refer only to the person's condition at creation.

changed_reading.before: The person was alone at creation.
changed_reading.after: The person is also alone as an accountable legal unit: companions and possessions cannot absorb the earnings by which that self is held.

context_deltas.mechanism: Intercession is literally an attempted joining of another person to the liable one, but that joining yields no benefit. This retrospectively sharpens ذَرْنِي ... وَحِيدًا as exclusion of a rescuing third party from the direct encounter.

activation_trace.role: Leaving or letting be supplies removal of outside handling.
Isolation and separateness supplies the resulting unpaired relation.
Benefit as the opposite of harm supplies the rescue that the later construction denies.
An intercessor joining another person supplies the attempted third-party pairing that fails.

structural_cues: The direct pair in 74:11 is later set against an explicitly nonbeneficial intercessory joining in 74:48.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separation and a later joining that cannot benefit; I infer backward clarification of the focus dyad, while the failed intercession may describe only a later collective outcome rather than this individual command.

changed_reading.before: Leave the speaker privately with the person.
changed_reading.after: Leave the person in a direct relation where no added advocate can pair with him to produce rescue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing divine will controls whether remembering occurs, while the final self-description includes both protective restraint and forgiveness. The handoff in the focus therefore grants exclusive jurisdiction, not a reader's license to reduce that jurisdiction to only one outcome.

activation_trace.role: Leaving or letting be supplies transfer of the case into the speaker's jurisdiction.
Separateness makes that jurisdiction exclusive rather than shared.
Will directed toward a thing supplies divine control over the closing act of remembrance.
Driving off harm through protection supplies one pole of the final divine claim.
Covering sin and preserving its bearer from the effect supplies the explicitly restorative pole.

structural_cues: The surah closes by subordinating human remembrance to divine will and naming both تقوى and مغفرة in relation to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exclusive will, protection, and forgiveness; I infer that ذَرْنِي transfers jurisdiction without itself fixing a single result, while the immediate narrative of this opponent still strongly activates punishment.

changed_reading.before: The handoff itself means only that punishment will be executed.
changed_reading.after: The handoff means that the created person's case belongs exclusively to divine agency; punishment is strongly activated, but the final description prevents jurisdiction from being lexically identical with punishment alone.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the detached-morsel branch of و ذ ر rather than the focus verb's direct leaving branch. It remains anchored through ذَرْ, وَحِيدًا, and the packet's accumulation and extension images; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for stripping supports, not as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ذَرْ and وَحِيدًا can jointly picture the target as a separated piece cut free from later accretions.

activation_trace.role: A detached morsel or piece supplies the branch-distant material image of cutting the target free.
Isolation and separateness stabilizes the detached-piece image at the focus word.
Accumulated abundance supplies an early image of material mass gathering in layers.
Abundant wealth gives the accumulation a concrete attachment around the person.
Connected extension makes those attachments spread outward from the original single unit.

changed_reading.before: The addressee is merely told to leave the person alone.
changed_reading.after: The person is imaginatively detached from accumulated wealth and extension until the original solitary created unit is exposed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the fabrication branch of خ ل ق is not the direct sense of خَلَقْتُ in the focus. It remains valid as a contrastive root activation when the created one later manufactures a transmitted-magic claim; downstream prose should frame it as wordplay between true creation and false fabrication, never translate خَلَقْتُ as 'I fabricated.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root in خَلَقْتُ holds both origination and false-fabrication branches, allowing the genuinely created person to become a derivative fabricator.

activation_trace.role: True originating and bringing into being establishes the asymmetry on the Creator's side.
Fabricating false speech supplies the latent counter-image later enacted by the created person's claim.
False saying or attribution gives the fabrication a spoken output.
Diversion and deception supplies the label with which the speaker tries to recast revelation.
Transmission of a report until it becomes received tradition supplies the invented genealogy assigned to the claim.

changed_reading.before: The verse only identifies God as this person's creator.
changed_reading.after: The person truly created by God later performs a counterfeit creative act, fabricating a verbal origin-story for the signs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the nearer reading takes وَحِيدًا as the created person's state, whereas this reading attaches the circumstantial singular to the first-person subject of خَلَقْتُ. It remains grammatically and branch-anchored in the focus; downstream prose should preserve it as a secondary scope possibility, not displace the strongly activated object-oriented reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: In خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا, the masculine singular circumstance can be tested against the implicit first-person creator as well as the created object.

activation_trace.role: Divine originating supplies the act whose agency may be qualified by the following circumstance.
God's exclusive oneness without partner supplies the subject-oriented scope: the Creator acted alone.

changed_reading.before: Leave Me with the person whom I created while he was alone.
changed_reading.after: Leave Me with the person whom I alone, without partner, created.

strongest_changes: The following grants turn وَحِيدًا into an original zero-state against which wealth, lineage, presence, and ease are later bestowed layers.
The 74:28 root echo reverses ذَرْ from a command to release into a process that leaves and preserves nothing.
The think-estimate-say sequence makes the proportioned creature a derivative counter-measurer who manufactures a verbal classification.
The universal self-earning-pledge construction converts solitary individuality into nontransferable liability, later sharpened by failed intercessory joining.
The closing protection and forgiveness language revises the handoff from a lexical synonym for punishment into exclusive divine jurisdiction.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses relational handoff, temporal origin, numerical individuation, and ambiguous exceptionalism into three roots. Context does not collapse these into one reading: it distributes them across bestowed accumulation, appetite, counter-design, exhaustive reversal, counted assay, legal pledge, failed pairing, and sovereign outcome.
remaining_uncertainties: The grammatical scope of وَحِيدًا remains live between the created object and, more remotely, the creating subject.
The detached-piece and false-fabrication branches are traceable but should remain analogical or contrastive rather than direct glosses of the focus forms.
Reading later universal accountability back into the individual's creation-state is coherent but depends on a reader-supplied temporal-to-legal bridge.
The punitive middle strongly specifies the opponent's trajectory, while the final protection and forgiveness language leaves the exact scope of the closing jurisdiction model open.
